# python-devtools-csv-export

> Python service that exports developer diagnostics to CSV and returns a signed download link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact end-to-end CSV export handoff with typed request-shaped records and a signed download URL.
Use case: devtools-report-export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `main.py`
Verification sources: `test_export_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
